(Starkiller Base) 4 |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{Film|VII}} |gender= |pronouns=new |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes=Green |skin=Fair |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[First Order]] **[[First Order military]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Weapon charged in fifteen minutes, sir.|First Order officer, to Armitage Hux|}} This '''individual''' was a [[human]] [[First Order officer|officer]] who served the [[First Order]] during its [[Cold War|conflict]] with the [[Resistance]]. Serving under the command of [[Colonel]] [[Erich S. Datoo]], they were stationed in the primary fire control room of the [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]] at the [[time]] of the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]]. As the Starkiller was draining the power of the [[Unidentified star (Starkiller Base)|sun]], they informed [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]] that the weapon would be fully charged in fifteen [[Standard minute|minutes]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|I didn't go through vigorous auditions. I just read once and got told I was in it. I just had no idea what I was going to do. So I turned up, and throughout the day, you just worked out what you were going to say.|Hannah John-Kamen|{{WebCite|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-features/resident-evil-star-hannah-john-kamen-on-immersive-sets-and-ant-man-and-the-wasp-memories-1235055054|text='Resident Evil' Star Hannah John-Kamen on Immersive Sets and 'Ant-Man and the Wasp' Memories|author=Davids, Brian|date=2021-11-30|work=[[Wikipedia:The Hollowood Reporter|''The Hollywood Reporter'']]|archivedate=20220207194300}}}} The character was portrayed by [[Hannah John-Kamen]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. Her role was confirmed in the movie's credits. John-Kamen auditioned only once for the role, reading a scene written specifically for the audition. She filmed her scenes at [[Pinewood Studios]] in [[2014]]. Due to the secrecy of the production, the actor was not told what role she was going to play until the day she arrived at the set, nor did she receive her parts of the script until later that day. In the fourth issue of the [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Adaptation|''Force Awakens'' comic adaptation]], the line "Configure!" is shown to be shouted by the individual,[[The Force Awakens Adaptation 4|''The Force Awakens Adaptation'' 4]] but in the film it is evidently said by another officer standing a few feet away. ==Appearances== *{{Film|VII}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] *[[The Force Awakens Adaptation 4|''The Force Awakens Adaptation'' 4]] ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=პირველი ორდენის უცნობი ოფიცერი 4 (ბაზა სტარკილერი) }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Officers of the First Order]]
